rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; Form 8960 (2025) p. 1, line 1, "Taxable interest (see instructions)". As on the Claude log: Form 1040 line 2b copies Schedule B line 4 (line 2 less line 3, which is zero because the Form 8815 exclusion is refused by sb.unsupported), so the amounts agree. The differences are project-refuses at f8960.refund and project-unknown with f8960.unsupported or f8960.refund withheld (the screens on the project's line 1; f8960.unsupported, which since PENDING-3 of the credits-misc package also names "section 404(k) dividends on employer securities held in an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP) and paid directly to you (Form 1099-DIV box 1a)" (i8960 p. 13, Line 7: "Section 404(k) dividends reported on line 2 (enter as a negative amount)"); the added item only widens a screen that refuses on Yes), and candidate-refuses on upstream Schedule B screens reached on partial records where the project stops at a withheld Form 8960 answer; none is on a completed return. No value difference. Triage executable-triage-v2 (`reviews/2025/transcription/triage/f8960.deepseek.json`; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 132 partial records from 40 bases; 2,127 comparisons): 1,857 agree; differences 6 candidate-refuses, 34 project-refuses, 230 project-unknown; on completed returns no difference. Project stands.

The candidate takes the smaller of Form 4952 lines 3 and 6 whether or not the filer itemizes; a filer who takes the standard deduction deducts nothing on Schedule A line 9. All 14 completed-return value differences are returns on which the project's sa.itemizes is false (checked on each witness's derivation): classm.s3.3, classm.s3.3.deepseek, classm.f5695.8.deepseek and classm.f5695.9 (project $0.00, candidate $312.00), classm.f1040.2 and classm.f1040.2.deepseek ($0.00 against $2,441.00), classm.tcw.16 ($0.00 against $3,499.00), and generated returns 124 ($0.07), 138 ($0.19), 236 ($661.60), 346 ($107.81), 373 ($6,296.87), 453 ($6,396.67) and 477 ($487.48), each against the project's $0.00. The completed-return candidate-refuses (f4952.unsupported, f4952.alternative_allocation; e.g. classm.f8962.1.deepseek, classm.clcw.2) and candidate-unknown (f4952.unsupported withheld; classm.s3.2, classm.sc.1) arise because Form 4952 lines 3 and 6 carry the Form 4952 screens; the project's line reads Schedule A line 9, which reads f4952.line8 only through the itemizing test and, since PENDING-6 of the credits-misc package, only when f4952.used holds (f4952 p. 3, Who Must File: "you must file Form 4952 to claim a deduction for your investment interest expense").
